description: Find live GTA 6 and gaming clipping campaigns on Whop Content Rewards and record them. Use when the user asks where to earn, which campaigns are open, what the pay per 1K views is, or to refresh campaigns.md.
---

# Campaign finder

Read pages live. Do not rely on memory; payouts and budgets change daily.

1. Check these sources, using the browser tools or by fetching the pages:
   - Whop Content Rewards: `https://whop.com/discover/` (search "GTA 6", "GTA VI", "gaming clipping", "content rewards") and the public campaign pages on `https://contentrewards.com/` (campaign links look like `contentrewards.com/c/campaigns/<id>`).
   - Clip (Clip Tech, LLC): `https://www.clip.tech/clippers` lists live campaigns with the rate per 1K views and the share of budget left, without login. The campaign briefs and rules live in their Discord, so ask the human to paste them. Their terms say payouts are Net 30 after a campaign ends and depend on the client paying; tell the human this in one line.
2. For each campaign that looks live, open its page and record:
   - name and creator or brand
   - platforms accepted
   - rate per 1K views (and any cap per clip or per person)
   - budget left or total budget
   - key rules: allowed source content, minimum length, required credit, hashtags, banned content, approval process
   - link
   - date checked
3. Write or update a row per campaign in `campaigns.md`. If a value is not visible on the page, write `unknown`. Never estimate or invent a number.
4. Rules that sit behind a login: tell the human which campaign and ask them to paste the rules text. Save it into `campaigns.md` under that campaign. Do not try to sign in, join, or accept terms for them.
5. Skip any campaign that asks for leaks, "play early", piracy, GTA Online money or AFK bots, or fake accounts. Say why in one line.
6. Report a short ranked list: campaign, rate, budget left, effort. No earnings promises: pay depends on approved views and each campaign's own rules.

The human joins campaigns and submits clips. You prepare and check the clips.

name: cheat-codes
description: GTA 6 cheat codes and cheat-guide posts. Use when the user asks for GTA 6 cheats, a cheat carousel, a "how to enter cheats" post, or wants to refresh cheat statuses after launch.
---

# Cheat codes

Answer only from `references/cheats.md`. Never add a code from memory.

## Make a 4-slide cheat carousel

1. Cover: "GTA 6 cheat codes" + "PS5 and Xbox Series X|S" + one hook line (for example "The $250,000 cheat is real").
2. How to enter: the 4 steps from the reference, plus the warning "Save first: cheats block saving, trophies and achievements for that session".
3. Player and combat: money, focus, armor, ammo codes with their unlock tasks, D-pad arrows as big buttons.
4. Vehicles and filters: spawns and screen filters with unlock tasks.

Style: dark background, one accent color, arrows as rounded key caps, the page handle on every slide. Caption: HOW TO template from the playbook, credit "codes via GameSpot" (or the source you used).

## Rules

- Post only codes with status `reported` or `verified`. Never post `unconfirmed` ones.
- Before posting any cheat code, check that it appears in at least one guide listed in the reference. If a code is not listed, write "code not found yet" and never invent the arrows. Never repost codes from the "Fake codes going around" list.
- Until the codes are verified in the game, say "reported" in the caption, not "confirmed".
- No mod menus, money glitches, GTA Online cheats or anything that breaks the rules of online play.

## After launch

When a code is tested in the game, set its status to `verified` with who tested it and the date. If it fails, mark it `wrong` and post a correction.

---

# Clip cutter

Run:

`python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/cut.py" jobs/<id> --pick <n> --layout fill|blur|facecam --hook "TEXT"`

- `fill`: crop the game video to fill the frame. Default for gameplay.
- `blur`: full video centered over a blurred copy. Use when cropping would cut off the action.
- `facecam`: gameplay with the streamer's camera shown. Use for reactions.

Before running:

1. Get 3 hook options from the `hook-writer` skill and use the best one.

After running:

1. Output is an mp4 in `media/edits`. Check it is 1080x1920, the hook shows in the first 2 seconds, captions are readable. No credit text is burned into the video; the poster credits the creator in the post.
2. Run `rule-check` on it. Fix and re-cut until it passes.
3. Trim 7 to 30 seconds for most clips. End on the payoff.
4. Show the human the file, and the caption text, and ask for "yes". Do not upload anything.

name: hook-writer
description: Write on-screen hooks for GTA 6 clips. Use whenever a clip needs a hook, a title or a caption opener, or when the user asks for hook options.
content:
---
name: hook-writer
description: Write on-screen hooks for GTA 6 clips. Use whenever a clip needs a hook, a title or a caption opener, or when the user asks for hook options.
---

# Hook writer

Write 3 options per clip. Sentence case. Short: 3 to 9 words fit the hook box.

## What works

- Number promise: "3 things you missed in this trailer"
- Shock fact: "This car is hidden in plain sight"
- Situation: "When the cops chase the wrong player"
- Negation: "You can't do this in GTA 5"
- Question: "Would you survive this chase?"
- Naming the streamer or creator when they are known: "Even [name] didn't see this coming"

## Reaction titles (twitch-reaction layout)

For a streamer's reaction clip the title sits on the seam between face and game for the whole clip. Formula: streamer name + reaction verb + what they reacted to, with CAPS on 2 or 3 key words.

- "Speed REALIZED why GTA 6 took ROCKSTAR 13 YEARS"
- "Kai LOST IT when the cops showed up in GTA 6"
- "Fighting Cops in GTA 6" (outlined style: short, 3 to 6 words)

Describe what happens on screen. Never put words in the streamer's mouth: no quotes they did not say, no made-up opinions. Emojis are optional, at most 2.

## What does not work

- Bare labels: "GTA 6 clip", "Funny moment"
- "Wait for it", "You won't believe this", "Watch till the end"
- Fake urgency or CAPS everywhere

## Rules

1. The clip must deliver the hook. If the hook says 3 things, show 3. No clickbait.
2. No spoilers for story moments in launch week. Label such clips SPOILER in the caption, not in the hook.
3. Never imply the page is Rockstar. Never write "official" for fan content.
4. Use "GTA 6". One emoji at most.
5. Do not reuse the same hook within a week. Check `log.md`.
6. Facts in the hook must be true and verified. Numbers must match the clip.

Return the 3 options and mark your pick.

content:
---
name: learning-loop
description: Log posts and learn from real numbers using scoreboard.csv, learning.md and payouts.csv. Use after a post goes out, at 12/24/72 hour reads, for the daily or weekly review, or when the user asks what is working or what they earned.
---

# Learning loop

Files in the page folder: `scoreboard.csv` (one row per post), `learning.md` (Wins, Losses, Current Rules), `payouts.csv` (real payouts only), `log.md`.

## Rules

1. Real numbers only. Ask the human to paste metrics or a screenshot. If a number is not available, leave it blank. Never guess.
2. Log every post when it goes out: post_id, date, time, platform, pillar, format, hook, length_sec, credit, test_name.
3. Reads at 12h, 24h and 72h fill views_12h, views_24h, views_72h, then likes, shares, replies, saves, followers_at_read.
4. One test per day. Change one variable only (hook style, length, posting time, caption length, still vs clip). Name it in `test_name`.
5. No verdict under 24 hours. Prefer the 72h read if the post is still moving.
6. `payouts.csv`: record only amounts the campaign or platform actually shows. Never project earnings.

## Daily (evening)

Best and worst post, one lesson written as a rule. Append to `learning.md`. Pick tomorrow's one test.

## Weekly

Top 3 and bottom 3 posts, median views by pillar, by time slot and by platform. Double down on what is above median. Rework or cut what stayed below median for a full week. Pick next week's tests. Update the customized `playbook.md` with what changed. Send the human a short summary.

Late-night reads: say what is still missing instead of filling it in.

`python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/live.py" <youtube-live-url> --minutes 60`

# Multilang

Non-English GTA pages are underserved, so one clip can feed several audiences.

Run after `clip-cutter` (the clip must already exist as `jobs/<id>/edits/clip_<n>.mp4` + `.json`):

`python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/translate.py" jobs/<id> --pick <n> --langs es,pt,de,ru [--voice]`

Output in `jobs/<id>/edits/`: `clip_<n>_<lang>.mp4` per language and one `clip_<n>_captions.md` with X, Instagram and TikTok/Shorts captions per language.

- Layout, hook box and loudness match the original cut. Override with `--layout`, `--hook` if needed.
- `--voice` adds a stock text-to-speech voice (edge-tts: es-ES-AlvaroNeural, pt-BR-AntonioNeural, de-DE-ConradNeural, ru-RU-DmitryNeural) that reads the translated hook only, in the first 2.5 seconds, with the original audio ducked under it.
- Never clone or imitate a real person's or streamer's voice. Stock voices only, and do not present the voiceover as the creator speaking.

Rules:

2. Translate facts, do not invent. Do not add claims, dates, prices or names that are not in the original clip or hook. Machine translation can slip: read each language's captions and hook before the human posts, and fix wrong or odd lines (ask the human if a language is unfamiliar).
3. Run `rule-check` on each language version, same as the original.
4. Post localized versions on separate localized pages or accounts, or as multi-language uploads where the platform supports them (for example YouTube multiple audio tracks and translated titles). Do not spam the same page with five versions of one clip.
5. Captions: X no hashtags; Instagram 3 to 5 hashtags; TikTok and Shorts short plus a few hashtags.
6. Do not upload anything. Show the files and captions to the human and wait for "yes".

content:
---
name: questions-to-posts
description: Turn repeated fan questions (Reddit threads and comments on our own posts) into HOW TO post drafts. Use when the user asks what people are asking, wants HOW TO ideas, or says to turn comment questions into posts.
---

# Questions to posts

Finds the questions fans keep asking, checks whether `facts.md` answers them, and drafts HOW TO posts from verified facts only.

## Command

Run from the page folder (where `facts.md` lives):

```
python scripts/questions.py --subs GTA6,GTA,GrandTheftAutoV --days 3 [--comments comments.txt] --out questions.md
```

- `--comments comments.txt`: comments pasted from our own posts, one per line.
- `--facts facts.md` (default), `--ideas idea-bank.md` (default), `--top 25`, `--min-count 1`.
- Uses public Reddit JSON, 1 request per second, waits and retries on 429. If Reddit blocks it, paste comments into `comments.txt` and run again.

## What you get

- `questions.md`: clusters ranked by count then upvotes. Each has the canonical question, count, example links, and either `answer found in facts.md: <line>` or `UNANSWERED: needs an official source`.
- Below the clusters: a HOW TO draft per answered cluster, in the playbook template (`HOW TO [DO THE THING] IN GTA 6`, numbered steps).
- `idea-bank.md`: every unanswered cluster is appended as a research task.

## After the run

1. Read each draft. The script copies steps from `facts.md` lines; it cannot judge order or whether a line is really a step. Fix order, trim to 3 to 5 steps, keep the wording true to the fact.
2. For each unanswered cluster, find an official source and add it to `facts.md` with the link, then rerun.
3. Run `rule-check` on the final text, then post. Same-day turnaround for repeated questions beats polish.

## Rules

1. Facts only from official sources (Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, Xbox), logged in `facts.md` with the link. Recheck anything older than 48 hours.
2. Never invent steps, numbers, dates or menu names. No source, no step. An unanswered question stays a research task.
3. No leaks, rumors, piracy, exploits or "play early" tricks, even if fans ask for them. Skip those clusters.
4. Credit: if a post builds on a fan's clip or find, credit with `🎥 @creator`. Do not quote or name Reddit users; the questions are only a signal of what to cover.
5. Never imply the page is Rockstar. Use "GTA 6".
6. Keep all-caps to the hook line only.

# Rule check

Run:

`python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/check.py" <clip.mp4> --campaign campaigns.md`

3. Read the caption yourself too. It must credit the creator in the text, no invented facts, no "official" wording, and match the platform's caption rules in the playbook.
4. The script cannot judge everything. If the campaign rules are `unknown` or missing, ask the human to paste them.
5. Only after all checks pass, send the human the clip, caption and credit and wait for "yes". The human posts it. Never auto-upload.

name: secrets-map
description: Build and post a verified map of GTA 6 hidden spots, rare cars, collectibles, money spots and easter eggs found by creators. Use when the user wants secrets, hidden spots, easter eggs or evergreen "hidden in Leonida" tip posts, or says scan a video for secrets.
content:
---
name: secrets-map
description: Build and post a verified map of GTA 6 hidden spots, rare cars, collectibles, money spots and easter eggs found by creators. Use when the user wants secrets, hidden spots, easter eggs or evergreen "hidden in Leonida" tip posts, or says scan a video for secrets.
---

# Secrets map

Entries live in `secrets.csv` (id, category, name, where, how, source_channel, source_url_with_timestamp, found_on, status, verified_by, notes). Categories: place, money, car, collectible, easter_egg, other. Status: unverified, verified, wrong.

## Commands

Run from the project folder with `.venv\Scripts\python scripts\secrets_map.py ...` (`--csv path` before the subcommand to use another file).

- `scan jobs/<id>`: reads `transcript.json` and `info.json`, finds secret-type mentions (hidden, secret, easter egg, money, cash, stash, collectible, rare car, location, spawn, unlock) and adds them as `unverified` with a quote and a `?t=` link to the source. Duplicates are skipped. Exploit-type mentions are skipped and printed.
- `add --name N --where W --how H --category place --channel C --url U`: manual entry.
- `verify <id> --by "<who/how>"`: only after the spot was checked in game (or confirmed by official material). Needs where, how and source channel filled in.
- `wrong <id>`: the tip did not hold up.
- `posts --out secrets-posts.md`: HOW TO tip and Spotlight drafts per verified entry, plus a "5 hidden spots in Leonida" carousel outline when 3 or more are verified.
- `map --out secrets.md`: table grouped by category.

## Flow

1. `scan` a transcribed video. Open each `?t=` link, read the quote, and rewrite the auto name/where/how in `secrets.csv` into a real tip.
2. Check it in the game. `verify` or `wrong`.
3. `posts`, then run `rule-check` on the drafts before they go out.

## Rules

1. Post verified entries only. Unverified is a lead, not a fact.
2. Credit the finder on every post (`🎥 channel` plus the timestamp link). Never present a creator's find as ours.
3. No glitches, exploits, money glitches, duplication, leaks or "play early" content. The script refuses them; do not work around it.
4. Scan output is a transcript guess. Rewrite the name, where and how by hand; do not post the raw quote.
5. No spoilers for story moments in launch week. Never imply the page is Rockstar. Use "GTA 6". X posts have no hashtags.

---
name: setup
description: First-run setup for the GTA 6 clip desk. Use when the user installs the plugin, says "set up", "start", or when ffmpeg, yt-dlp or faster-whisper are missing or the page folder does not exist yet.
---

# Setup

Do the work yourself. Ask the human only what is listed here.

## 1. Install tools (no questions)

Check each with `ffmpeg -version`, `yt-dlp --version`, `python -c "import faster_whisper, numpy"`. Install only what is missing:

- ffmpeg. Windows: `winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg -e --source winget`. macOS: `brew install ffmpeg`. Linux: `sudo apt install -y ffmpeg`
- Python packages, all systems: `python -m pip install -U -r "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/requirements.txt"` (faster-whisper, numpy, requests and a fresh yt-dlp; the scripts prefer the pip yt-dlp, because an old yt-dlp gets HTTP 403 from YouTube)
- Re-run the pip line once a week: YouTube changes often and yt-dlp updates follow.

If a winget/brew/apt install needs a new terminal for PATH, say so in one line and re-check. Never spend money or add a card.

## 2. Ask at most 4 questions, in ONE numbered message

1. Page name and handle (@).
2. Platforms (for example X, Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts).
3. Niche angle (one lane: tips and hidden spots, fast news, funny moments, cars and customization).
4. Time zone.

If the human already gave an answer, do not ask it again. Skip the message if all four are known.

## 3. Show the plan, ask ONE "yes"

List the folder you will create and the files in it, then ask for a single "yes". After the yes, create (in the current directory, in a folder named after the page):

- `playbook.md` (copy from `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/playbook/references/playbook.md` and fill the [BRACKETED] fields with the answers)
- `facts.md` (verified facts only, each with an official source link)
- `idea-bank.md`, `watchlist.md`, `log.md`
- `scoreboard.csv` with this header line only:
  `post_id,date,time,platform,pillar,format,hook,length_sec,credit,views_12h,views_24h,views_72h,likes,reposts_or_shares,replies_or_comments,saves_or_bookmarks,followers_at_read,test_name,notes`
- `learning.md` with headings Wins, Losses, Current Rules
- `takedowns.md`
- `campaigns.md` (title line and an empty table: name, platform, rate per 1K views, budget left, rules, link, checked on)
- `payouts.csv` with header `date,campaign,platform,post_url,views,rate_per_1k,est_payout,status` (managed by `scripts/payouts.py`)
- folders `media/official`, `media/raw`, `media/edits`

## 4. Finish

Tell the human, in 3 lines: what was installed, where the folder is, and the next step (`campaign-finder`, then `trend-radar`). Remind them that they approve every post and that nothing is uploaded automatically.

# Twitch reaction clips

Face on top, game below, a big title on the seam. The format of most viral GTA 6 streamer clips.

## 1. Find the streamer (no Twitch account or key needed)

`python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/streams.py" --query "gta 6"` lists the top live Grand Theft Auto VI streams on Twitch and YouTube, ranked by viewers. Pick a streamer who runs a clipping campaign (check `campaigns.md`), or one whose clips you have permission to post.

## 2. Get the moment

- Live: `python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/live.py" https://twitch.tv/<login> --minutes 60` records the stream, reads Twitch chat anonymously and cuts a clip every time chat explodes.
- After the fact: `python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/moments.py" <twitch VOD or clip URL> --top 8` scores the VOD and writes `candidates.md`.

## 3. Cut the reaction clip

```
python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/cut.py" jobs/<id> --pick 1 --layout react --cam auto \
  --title "Speed REALIZED why GTA 6 took ROCKSTAR 13 YEARS" --title-style box --captions bubble
```

- `--cam auto` finds the streamer's webcam itself (face detection plus the webcam frame around it). It prints where it found the cam. If it finds no stable face it falls back to the blur layout and says so. Check the first frame once; if the crop is wrong, pass `--cam x:y:w:h` fractions.
- `--title-style box`: white band with bold black text on the seam. `--title-style outline`: white text with a thick black outline across the top of the game, for short titles ("Fighting Cops in GTA 6").
- `--captions bubble`: white speech bubble ("Oh my god!"). `word`: word-by-word captions. `none`: title only.
- Write the title with `hook-writer` (reaction titles section).

## Rules

- Clip a streamer only inside their campaign or with permission. Credit them in the post caption, not on the video.
- Titles describe what happened. Never invent a quote or an opinion.
- Run `rule-check` before posting. No spoilers in the title during launch week.
